verdict.rationale: Docs confirm 83(b) election generation as a built-in feature and ASC 718 stock option expense reporting is automated from cap table data, but there is no mention of Rule 701 disclosure threshold tracking or Form 3921 filing generation anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: Rule 701 threshold tracking/alerts, Form 3921 filing generation, and any explicit 'automatic compliance tracking' workflow tying these three items together.
